lines.en: scene imanilustnaming3
: I don’t really get it either. But it’s Nodoka, so there’s probably no point in trying to make sense of it.

lines.en: : I just wanted to spend some time alone with you since I doubt we’ll be able to talk much at all tomorrow with everyone else vying for your attention.
lines.zh: : 我只是想和你单独待一会儿——明天所有人都要来争你的注意力,我怀疑到时候我们根本说不上话。

lines.en: scene imanilustnaming4

lines.en: scene imanilustnaming6
: You’ve seen her?
lines.zh: : 你见过她了?

lines.zh: : 嗯?当然见过。我就住她隔壁。

lines.zh: : 而她……什么都没说?

lines.zh: : 她只说了「在里面安分点,不然我他妈把门踹开,把你揍到失聪」,这感觉相当离谱。

lines.en: : And that was particularly odd because I wasn’t even making any noise that night. But hey, I know she’s got shit goin’ on.
lines.zh: : 而且尤其怪的是,那晚我根本没出声。不过嘿,我知道她身上有一堆烂摊子。

lines.en: : I see...

lines.zh: : 有……不过我觉得不该由我说。只是也许,别在 Yumi 面前提她。

lines.en: scene imanilustnaming7
: Oh yeah, Yumi! She’s actually been, like...weirdly present lately. Like she didn’t even put up a fight when we mentioned the Dorm Wars this year. And-

lines.en: It’s somewhat surprising how often I forget how close to my height she is, though I can’t say if that’s due to her demeanor or the fact that everyone else is just so small.
lines.zh: 我总忘记她和我的身高差有多小,这有点令人惊讶——虽然我分不清这是因为她的做派,还是因为周围所有人都太矮。

lines.en: In a sense though, I guess that’s kind of how it always was.
lines.zh: : 不过某种意义上,我想一直如此。

lines.en: Just a never ending sequence of toeing the line between wanting to be somewhere and wanting to be nowhere at all.
lines.zh: : 只是一场没有尽头的拉锯——想在某个地方,和想哪里都不在。

lines.en: I hope she enjoys it, at least.

I’m reminded of Christmas in the way we enter her room. Just this time, it’s far less passionate and steamy and a lot more...cute. At least for now.

lines.en: Once the door is closed, she rests her head on my shoulder and looks up at me with those bright blue eyes I’ve found myself unintentionally falling into many times before.
lines.zh: 门一关上,她把头靠上我的肩,抬起那双亮蓝色的眼睛望着我——我已不止一次不自觉地坠入那双眼睛。

lines.en: Maybe I am growing? Or maybe I am just permanently sick.
